slot_or_package: Demon tribal / repeatable ETB token engine
candidate_role: Demon support and repeatable Demon-copy engine
commander_specific_hypothesis: Ardyn grants Demons menace, lifelink, and haste. At the beginning of combat on your turn it can create a 5/5 black Demon token copy of a creature card from any graveyard. That token entering triggers Be'lakor's Demon-entry damage ability; copied ETB abilities also trigger.
expected_benefit: Adds a recurring Demon entry each combat, immediate attack pressure, access to opposing graveyards, and repeatable Be'lakor damage. High within-project rank and direct tribal synergy support the inclusion.
tradeoff: Ardyn costs eight mana, is not itself a Demon, and loses Raphael's +1/+1 tribal bonus and Devil recursion. Ardyn's token engine requires a legal creature card in a graveyard and a combat step.
oracle_rules_legality_checked: PASS — current Oracle text, mono-black color identity, and Commander legality reviewed; no identity conflict.
decision_status: AUTO-APPROVED/LOCKED — standing user instruction; all required checks passed.
test_plan: No matched-start simulator or representative multiplayer playtest available; no win-rate claim.
